camdrones.guide.scene.camera_drone.callo: ATTI: no GPS – drifts with the wind
C: slow and smooth for footage
N: sticks released – GPS holds position and horizon
The frame tilts, the picture stays level
Stops in front of the wall
GPS, compass and barometer keep it in place
S: fast, leans further, no obstacle stop
camdrones.guide.scene.camera_drone.descr: Position hold, flight modes, gimbal, ATTI and obstacle stop
Under blocks or in caves there is no GPS fix. The drone switches to ATTI: it keeps its height but drifts with the wind – steer it yourself.
The 3-axis gimbal keeps the picture level while the frame tilts. Tilt the camera up and down with the keys below.
Arm and climb. Let go of the sticks and the camera drone brakes and holds its position and height, even in light wind.
Unlike an FPV quad, the sticks set the speed. N: GPS holds position and horizon. C: slow and smooth for footage. S: fast, needs space.
N, C, S: the flight modes
Obstacle sensors stop the drone in front of walls. Compact drones only look down, Tour and Cine look all around.

camdrones.guide.scene.first_mission.desc: Pair the flight planner, set waypoints and fly a mission
camdrones.guide.scene.first_mission.step: The drone takes off and flies the waypoints, even when you are not in FPV. Pause stops it in the air, in FPV the sticks take over.
With the end “to start” or “land” the drone lands. Over a landing pad it centres itself and touches down in the middle.
Put the drone down. Sneak and right-click it with the flight planner in your hand – the tablet is now paired with this drone.
“Send” in the editor stores the mission on the drone. Start it in the editor, with the Mission button in the service menu or the key.
Right-click blocks with the flight planner: each click adds a waypoint above the block. Right-click into the air to open the editor.

Without a fitting accessory the action is skipped.
camdrones.planner.field.action.tooltip: What happens at the point: nothing, photo, start or stop recording.
camdrones.planner.field.every.tooltip: Only when timed: the time between two triggers in ticks (20 ticks = 1 second); the seconds show at Repeat. The timer starts at this waypoint and runs until a waypoint with another accessory setting, at the latest until the last waypoint (not on the way back). An accessory with a minimum interval, such as a dispenser, never fires faster. Click: ±1 tick, Shift: ±20 ticks.
camdrones.planner.field.heading: Look
camdrones.planner.field.heading.tooltip: Where nose and camera point: along the course, fixed, at a point of interest or free for the operator.

camdrones.planner.field.repeat.tooltip: “only here”: the accessory action runs once at this waypoint. “from here”: at this and at every following waypoint. “every … s” (timed): from this waypoint on at the interval from the field Every, also in flight and while waiting. Both last until a point has another accessory setting or “Stop repeat”, at the latest until the last waypoint.
camdrones.planner.field.speed.tooltip: Speed on the way to this point; “base speed” uses the mission speed.
camdrones.planner.field.tilt.tooltip: Gimbal tilt at this point, blended smoothly in between.
camdrones.planner.field.wait.tooltip: How long the drone hovers at this point.

camdrones.planner.support.fpv_pilot: It flies missions only without a pilot: take off the goggles, then Start. With a pilot it stays a normal FPV drone.
camdrones.planner.support.fpv_sensors: Without a nav FC there is no obstacle sensing – the mission flies the planned line.
camdrones.planner.support.gps_missing: GPS: only %1$s of %2$s satellites – no mission starts without open sky
camdrones.planner.support.notice.fpv: FPV drone: start only without a pilot
camdrones.planner.support.notice.no_gps: No GPS at the drone (%1$s/%2$s satellites)
camdrones.planner.support.reason.no_acce: no accessory with actions on the drone
camdrones.planner.support.reason.no_leds: no LED strip on the drone
camdrones.planner.support.reason.no_ligh: this Propwash version does not let add-ons switch the LEDs yet
camdrones.planner.support.reason.unknown: Drone out of sight – checked in flight
camdrones.planner.support.repeated: Repeats the accessory action of waypoint %s
camdrones.planner.support.timed: Continues every %2$s ticks (%3$s s) from waypoint %1$s
camdrones.planner.support.unknown: Drone out of sight – its equipment is unknown. Actions are checked in flight.
camdrones.planner.template.circle.toolti: 12 waypoints in a 20 m circle around the selected point of interest or the map centre, looking at the centre
camdrones.planner.template.line.tooltip: Insert a point every 10 m between the last two waypoints, otherwise 60 m straight ahead
camdrones.planner.template.reveal.toolti: Backwards and rising away from the subject, camera stays on the subject
camdrones.planner.title: Flight Planner
camdrones.planner.tooltip.unlinked: Not paired – sneak + right-click your drone
camdrones.planner.tooltip.use: Right-click the air: editor · a block: waypoint · Sneak + right-click a marker: delete
camdrones.planner.upload.distance: Waypoint %s too far from the start
camdrones.planner.upload.not_found: Drone not found – is it loaded in this world?
camdrones.planner.upload.unavailable: The drone cannot take a mission right now
camdrones.planner.view.result.not_found: Drone not found – is it loaded in this world?
camdrones.planner.view.result.ok: Camera view saved on the drone
camdrones.planner.view.result.unavailabl: The drone does not take settings right now
camdrones.record.flashback.empty: Flashback recording ended without a camera path: Flashback recorded nothing in that time
camdrones.record.flashback.handed_over: Gimbal camera path handed to Flashback: scene “%s” with %s keyframes
camdrones.record.flashback.refused: The camera path could not be handed to Flashback
camdrones.record.incompatible: This Flashback version is not supported – direct recording applies
camdrones.record.mode.direct.tooltip: Records the gimbal picture directly as a video or photo into the propwash/recordings folder. Works only in live view: as pilot, as camera operator or in the live view from the flight planner.
camdrones.record.mode.flashback.tooltip: Videos, photos and waypoint recordings of the gimbal camera go into the Flashback recording as a camera path – also in the background without live view and without FPS cost. When the drone is out of sight, the server sends its surroundings along.
camdrones.record.needs_flashback: Flashback recording needs the Flashback mod (Fabric)
camdrones.record.needs_live_view: Direct recording needs the live view – Flashback mode records in the background
camdrones.switch.course_lock.description: Forward always flies the stored direction; yaw only turns nose and camera.
camdrones.switch.follow_me.description: Follows the owner while the switch is on.
camdrones.switch.gimbal_fpv.description: The image rolls with the frame like an FPV camera; the tilt stays stabilized. Overrides follow/lock.
camdrones.switch.gimbal_lock.description: The gimbal follows the frame or keeps its direction.
camdrones.switch.gimbal_recenter.descrip: Centers the gimbal; pressed twice, it points straight down.
camdrones.switch.mission_start.descripti: Starts the drone's active mission or resumes it.
camdrones.switch.mode_cine.description: Slow flight with smoothed sticks for calm shots. Propwash's flight mode Horizon selects C as well.
camdrones.switch.mode_cycle.description: Switches N → C → S like Propwash's flight mode key (default R); the last change on the radio or key counts.
camdrones.switch.mode_normal.description: Speed-controlled flight; let go of the sticks to brake and hold position. Propwash's flight mode Angle selects N as well.
camdrones.switch.mode_sport.description: Manual flight with a 35° angle limit, without obstacle braking. Propwash's flight mode Acro selects S as well.
camdrones.switch.pause.description: Pauses the mission or smart function and hovers in place.
camdrones.switch.pilot_view.description: Switches your picture between the fixed FPV camera on the frame and the gimbal camera. Only without a camera operator; every flight starts with the FPV camera.
camdrones.switch.poi_here.description: Sets a point of interest at the image center and circles it.
camdrones.switch.waypoint_add.descriptio: Stores position, height and heading as a waypoint.
gamerule.camdrones.allow_autonomy.descri: Camera drones fly without a pilot: hold, missions, point of interest and follow me, also after leaving the FPV view. Off: the drone lands or returns home as without the add-on.
Follow me on other players, always with their consent. Off: only the owner, own pets and mounts.
gamerule.camdrones.allow_operator.descri: A second player may operate the gimbal camera of a camera drone.
gamerule.camdrones.max_altitude.descript: Highest altitude of camera drones in metres above the take-off point, 0 = off.
Longest time a camera drone may fly without a pilot, 1 to 60 minutes. Then it returns home or lands; it ends earlier when the battery runs low.
gamerule.camdrones.max_distance.descript: Largest distance of camera drones from the take-off point in blocks, 0 = only Propwash's radio range.
